name: clrn_visual
description: Visual regression tests for LaiWan Web (Playwright toHaveScreenshot)

scripts.test: docker compose run --rm -e VISUAL_LOCALES=zh-Hans -e VISUAL_FILTER -e VISUAL_SCOPE -e VISUAL_TEST_SHARDS visual test
scripts.test:all: docker compose run --rm -e VISUAL_LOCALES=all -e VISUAL_FILTER -e VISUAL_SCOPE -e VISUAL_TEST_SHARDS visual test
scripts.test:locales: docker compose run --rm -e VISUAL_LOCALES=zh-Hant,en -e VISUAL_FILTER -e VISUAL_SCOPE -e VISUAL_TEST_SHARDS visual test
scripts.reference:zh: docker compose run --rm -e VISUAL_LOCALES=zh-Hans -e VISUAL_FILTER -e VISUAL_SCOPE visual reference
scripts.approve: docker compose run --rm -e VISUAL_FILTER -e VISUAL_SCOPE -e VISUAL_TEST_SHARDS visual approve
scripts.test:scenarios: node --import tsx --test scenarios.test.ts run-visual-config.test.ts docker-env.test.ts src/support/runWithContext.test.ts
